snippet.title: Noctheria – Official Trailer | N64-Style Survival Horror Zelda-like | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Noctheria is a survival horror adventure inspired by the Zelda games of the N64 era with a mix of Survival Horror. Take control of Ophelia and explore a haunted Island full of secrets, solve its puzzles, find key items and survive what lurks inside: giant spiders, wolves and things that shouldn’t exist.

🕯️ The FREE DEMO is out now on Steam. Wishlist it and tell me what you think!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776070/Noctheria/

✦ Retro N64-inspired visuals
✦ Zelda-like exploration and puzzles
✦ Horror atmosphere and boss fights
✦ Lore hidden in every corner of the mansion

Developed by ZombieByte Games.

Follow the development:
